purpose: Describe whether student-CEM candidate-bank dispersion contracts across rounds 10/20/30 while student-top30 access to the teacher-best candidate worsens; use the pattern only to judge whether a separate fixed-exploration mixture-CEM mechanism experiment is motivated.

analysis.unit: Source episode and replan solve (step 0 or 25); rounds within each solve are paired repeated measurements.
analysis.dispersion: Population std over the 300 candidates per each of 50 coordinates, for all candidates and student-cost top30. Use saved raw proposal coordinates without clipping or invented bounds; the pinned CEM proposal coordinates are unconstrained.
analysis.teacher_best_access: Keep raw minimum teacher cost in the full bank and raw minimum teacher cost among student-cost top30. Best-cost gap is student-top30 minimum minus full-bank minimum; standardize all rounds by the same episode/replan solve's round10 teacher-cost population std.
analysis.aggregation: Keep train and validation separate. Preserve per-episode/solve bank measurements, report medians by split x replan step x round, and paired round deltas within each episode/solve.
analysis.descriptive_readout: By split and replan step, round10-to-round30 contraction means lower median full-bank and student-top30 mean coordinate std. Best-cost access worsens when median round10-scale standardized gap increases. Report the joint pattern descriptively; no threshold or gate.

interpretation_limits: The 25538135 validation split was already used by the residual-ranker gate; its posthoc values are descriptive, not an independent gate or tuning signal.
